subject: Mehndi night!! and a few tiny things

messages.text:
Meera!! Hi hi hi. How are the kids? Is Arjun still refusing to wear anything but the dinosaur pyjamas? Rohan was the same at that age, I swear he wore the green ones to my mother-in-law's seventieth and she still brings it up. She said (and I quote) "at least the dinosaur had the decency to be ironed." Anyway, that is Amma for you, nothing is ever just a comment.

So, the wedding. Deepa's mehndi night is Friday the 14th at my place, starting around 6. Things I need, and I know it's a lot, sorry sorry:
1) could you tell me by Sunday how many of you are coming, adults and kids separately, because the caterer wants numbers on Monday;
2) do you still have that big brass thali set from your mum? Deepa would love it for the entrance, only if it isn't a bother;
3) and Aunt Lakshmi is flying in on the 13th at 4:40pm, can you or Vikram pick her up? Totally fine if not, I'll ask Raj.

Hugs to everyone, lots of love,
Sunita x

Say whether she can lend the brass thali set (optional, only if no bother)
